newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends weaker, off lows,awaits LME data.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends weaker, off lows,awaits LME data.

text.p: COMEX copper ended lower after a lackluster, quiet session, trading within a relatively narrow range.
Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities said the market was not expecting as much of a drawdown in LME stocks Friday as in the past few reporting periods.

"This kept the market under pressure and there was some profit-taking," she said, adding that sentiment was also dampened by reports quoting Codelco saying Sumitomo Corp had declined to cooperate with the Chilean company into its probe of trading losses by Codelco's former head trader, Juan Pablo Davila.
December COMEX settled 0.25 cent weaker at 88.85 cents per pound, traded 89.10 to 87.75 cents. Spot October was settled 0.25 cent firmer at 90.10 cents.
Volume was estimated at 8,000 lots compared to Wednesday's official 8,288 lots.
